title: Niccolò Guidi di Bagno to the Secretariat of State, Paris, 5 January 1652 (AAV Francia 104; DECODE R5622)

steps.what: Downloaded and inspected all five authenticated DECODE images.
Checked the exact shelfmark and adjacent DECODE records; no same-text or same-key sibling was found.
Tested Lasry's reconstructed Francia 346 key; its mandatory 6 separator is incompatible with R5622's repeated 66 and 666, and a checked line gives malformed groups and no Italian.
Tried whole-line OCR, digit segmentation and glyph clustering on ff. 6r-7v.
Searched exact shelfmark, sender, date and route and checked the Ranuzzi/Acta Nuntiaturae Gallicae lead; no edition of this despatch or online decifrati register was found.

outcome.notes: Attempted, open. Francia 346 is excluded; needs a reliable manual transcription and the 1652 Paris nunciature key or Secretariat decipherment.

gaps.detail: no matching key, decipherment or clear copy; Francia 346 excluded
human-readable scans, but OCR and automatic segmentation are not reliable enough

prior.where: No edition or decipherment found; DECODE has no transcription or attached document.

human: Project-level: supplied an authenticated DECODE session and posed the target with the suggestion to test the Francia 346 key. No target-specific reading or transcription was supplied.
